section_description: Background models, prose composition and Jev
lead: Choose separate models for fast background work and final prose.
aside: Nothing these lanes write is the Keeper's prose, so a quick model here shortens every turn without touching a word of the story.
live: Changes apply to the next task, including in a running table.
auto_subtitle: Every lane runs on whichever model the Keeper is set to
thinking_lead: Choose the reasoning effort the fast model runs at. A lane that spends its time thinking keeps the player waiting, so the lanes do not follow the table's effort; they run at their own steady level unless you pick one here.
empty: No models in Model Management yet. Sign in a provider there, then come back.
failed: Could not read or save model settings. Try again.
fast_description: Used for background work, reviews, memory and interface presentation.
author_description: Turns the Keeper’s selected content, NPC intent, personality and emotion into the final prose.
